full_details: At nine the plot for two o'clock does not have you. You went home. In the afternoon you left the messenger's half-line empty and wrote a twelvemonth and a day under it. You did not go into the play. After the Shrew, two men from Gray's Inn came to the parlour door with wine and the story of the twenty-eighth of December. The hall was thronged. The Templars' ambassador left in dudgeon. The dancing was ruined. A company of base and common fellows was brought in to crown it with a play. Kemp asked to have that in writing, and offered to have been the sorcerer the Inn blamed. Heminges's book says Greenwich in the afternoon and Gray's Inn that night. Kemp swears it was the night before. Burbage remembers the cold on the river, and laughs at what any clerk will make of two houses in one night. You did not enter the hall. You promised Burbage the fifth act at the Jackdaw on Saturday, after the reckoning. He has not heard it. At home you said your legs say one day. The Rose's bill is Faustus. You did not go.
one_sentence: You heard two students at the parlour door call the company base and common.
title: Heard the company called base and common
